newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Winsan China seen in HK$600 mln float-sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Winsan China seen in HK$600 mln float-sources.

text.p: Property trading and development concern Winsan China (Investment) Co Ltd is expected to raise about HK$600 million in a flotation of shares later in July, market sources said.

Sources said the Hong Kong-based property group was expected to issue about 330 million shares at about HK$1.80 per share, giving a price to earnings multiple of about nine times and discount to net asset value (NAV) per share of about 31 percent.
The float is expected to comprise of a public offering in Hong Kong and an international placement, they said.
China Development Finance Co is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, sources said.
Sources said listing terms and time schedule of the issue had not been finalised yet.

They said Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd, Beijing Enterprises Holdings Ltd and Bank of China Group were expected to take HK$20 million stake in Winsan, a company engaging in property trading and development in China.
The three strategic investors were not immediately available for comment.
